meta.title: Client-Side API Communication & Endpoint Discovery
meta.plainExplanation: Inspects Single Page Application (SPA) HTML, JavaScript bundles (Angular, React, Vue, Next.js), runtime configuration files (/assets/config.json, /config.json, /env.js), and CSP connect-src directives to map client-to-API communication, discover backend REST/GraphQL/WebSocket endpoints, and detect unauthenticated API data exposure or insecure API configurations.
meta.whyItMatters: Modern SPAs communicate directly with same-origin or external backend APIs via Angular HttpClient, Fetch, Axios, or GraphQL. meta.remediation: Use environment-specific production builds (e.g., Angular environment.prod.ts without dev proxy.conf.json localhost URLs), enforce HTTPS for all API origins, require authentication on sensitive REST/GraphQL endpoints, remove secrets from public /assets/config.json files, and restrict allowed API origins via Content-Security-Policy connect-src and strict CORS policies.

meta.title: Web Cache Poisoning & Unkeyed Header Reflection (X-Forwarded-Host / X-Original-URL)
meta.plainExplanation: Probes an isolated cache-busted URL (?secscan_cb=<nonce>) with unkeyed forwarding headers (X-Forwarded-Host, X-Host, X-Original-URL) and performs a clean follow-up request to verify whether the reflected header is stored in a shared HTTP cache.
meta.whyItMatters: If a reverse proxy or CDN caches a response containing an unkeyed header value, an attacker can poison the shared cache and serve malicious scripts or redirects to all visitors.
meta.defaultFix: Include X-Forwarded-Host / X-Forwarded-Scheme in the cache key (Vary header), or configure the web server and framework to ignore unauthenticated X-Forwarded-Host and X-Original-URL headers.
meta.remediation: Include X-Forwarded-Host / X-Forwarded-Scheme in the cache key (Vary header), or configure the web server and framework to ignore unauthenticated X-Forwarded-Host and X-Original-URL headers.

groupedFindings.fix: Include X-Forwarded-Host / X-Forwarded-Scheme in the cache key (Vary header), or configure the web server and framework to ignore unauthenticated X-Forwarded-Host, X-Host, X-Original-URL, and X-Rewrite-URL headers.

meta.remediation: Use textContent / innerText instead of innerHTML or document.write, sanitize dynamic HTML with DOMPurify, and always validate event.origin inside postMessage handlers.
